name: tab-session-restored-history
description: The restore of a tab reads its stored session, which holds a session history for the tab with a file, and holds none for a tab without a file, and the store answers the file of the tab with null.
reason: The tab sessions read and write the tab-sessions files of the configuration directory and the document regions read the state of a window; the producer builds neither state (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
